status: Experimental durable journal discovery; not selected-prefix recovery or a serving engine
behavior: Immutable registration names each fresh root journal and its captured predecessor
Exactly one physical registration PUT precedes the conditional root claim; an unknown upload requires an exact positive read
Unresolved upload sends no root metadata mutation; a late orphan upload cannot enter the winning ancestry
Registration traversal starts at the controller identity and follows persisted parent links without object listing
Missing, corrupt, incompatible or oversized registrations fail without advancing the cursor
The root journal writer can be taken once under a live interval; this is not database readiness or acknowledgement authority

limits.traversal_bookkeeping: Fixed size; callers must bound retained outputs
limits.recovery_io: Linear in ownership history; no checkpoint index or compaction

model.coverage: Three winning generations retain at least two acknowledged-journal markers
model.acknowledgement_markers: Overapproximation for discoverability only; no data, prefix or lease composition

http_bindings_extended: Native B2 metadata fixture with both cancelled-claim orders
S3 fixture loses an applied registration PUT response; exact read resolves it before root publication
tests.cold_discovery: Drops all controllers, writers, readers and historical register snapshots; starts a fresh clock origin; recovers three earlier journals and frames from current register plus immutable objects without listing
tests.corruption: Every byte plus nine checksum-valid semantic mutations, oversized input and missing object; cursor does not advance on error

assumptions: Immutable object writes are durable and exact reads do not invent bytes; positive read resolution is not inferred from absence
Fresh root identities, exact nonce-changing provider comparisons and trusted protocol credentials
No external deletion or alteration of referenced registrations
Ownership timing and invocation assumptions remain those documented for the candidate root controller
limitations: No selected-prefix catalog: recovered frames alone do not authorize database acknowledgements
No automatic election or renewal driver, system clock adapter, production timing profile, placement or routing
No registration collector, physical upload admission, indexed checkpoints or bounded recovery I/O
No complete composition, Rust refinement or liveness proof
Local fixtures only; no new cloud benchmark or production-readiness claim
Current HTTP engine retains conditional read barriers
